identity.name: OpenMM 7 DHFR explicit-solvent energy conservation benchmark

outcome_definition.quantity: Mean linear total-energy drift for each precision mode

citations.citation: Eastman et al. (2017), OpenMM 7: Rapid development of high performance algorithms for molecular dynamics, PLoS Comput Biol 13(7): e1005659
S1 Supporting Information: benchmark scripts, README and inputs

source_licences.intended_use: Download, execute, modify and report scientific benchmark results

source_licences.component: OpenMM API, application layer and bundled force-field inputs
source_licences.conditions: Retain notices and disclaimers on redistribution.
Redistributed modifications to OpenMM CUDA platform require corresponding source under applicable LGPL terms.

stock_cuda_image.reason: Stock image specification, GPU architecture, driver, Python and toolchain versions not supplied. Historical CUDA compatibility pending reproduction.

evidence.fact: Historical installation guide specifies NVIDIA CUDA 7.5.
Selected script explicitly requests CUDA and imports simtk.openmm plus scipy.stats.linregress.

size.data_scope: dhfr.pdb plus amber99sbildn.xml and tip3p.xml; excludes software and download archives
size.reason: No published or measured peak host/device working set found; data size alone cannot determine size class.

scoring.reason: Table 5 reports estimates and standard errors, without pass/fail tolerances. Standard error is not acceptance tolerance.
scoring.comparison: Report measured means, standard errors and differences from published references; no reference-based pass/fail.

repeatability.protocol: Ten fresh CUDA contexts per precision mode; random initial velocities at 300 K. Repeat fixed workload without scale search.
repeatability.reason: setVelocitiesToTemperature is called without seed argument; original seed numbers and explicit seed controls are unavailable. Exact trajectories cannot be reproduced from published seeds.

search.query: OpenMM DHFR explicit solvent benchmark benchmark.py CUDA independent simulations seeds

candidates.qualification: Public executable Python code, published README command and accessible DHFR and force-field inputs.

gate.reason: Published tolerances and confirmed stock compatibility are not required by stated intake gate; stock_environment is not false.

gate_scripts.reason: Prompt names no gate scripts; JSON structure and cross-file consistency checked locally.
